burden_and_friction.observation: Strict pre-state/post-state protection comparisons and connected-GitHub write limitations increased operator steps but prevented silent protection drift.
The sentinel classifier is cheap after acquisition, but complete private-estate snapshot acquisition remains an external completeness burden.
Streamlined execution removes repeated approval ceremony but shifts work toward accurate material-closure classification and immutable dependency tracking.
Public communication requires continued synchronization with certified/audited source identities and permanent exclusions.
Mathematical communication requires exact theorem hypotheses, claim classes, source identities, counterexamples, and replay provenance to remain synchronized.

The four new Stage-A packages each used a nine-file communication/conformance envelope. For non-promotional pilot evidence, generating standing G8/G9 placeholder records may be unnecessary ceremony; future templates should defer creation of promotion-specific records until promotion is actually requested, provided discoverability and authority boundaries remain explicit.

unresolved_ambiguities: Whether the present nine-file-per-pilot packet is the minimum useful durable record or can be reduced without weakening claim/evidence/provenance boundaries.
How to obtain representative empirical false-positive and false-negative evidence without manufacturing artificial projects or risky live transitions.
How complete private-estate acquisition should be governed if the GHOS sentinel is later scheduled or automated.
Whether a future v1.0 promotion should use a newly activated independent Referee mechanism; the current delegated Referee office record is not effective on the measurement baseline.

Whether the P04 experimental/computational deficit should be filled by an already-completed real result found in later evidence discovery or by a future naturally occurring experiment, rather than by manufacturing a pilot solely for coverage.

How to extend the demonstrated Markdown-to-MkDocs orphan check into the full document/web/source/candidate/asset/static/TeX/JSON/directory coverage required by criterion 7 without building an over-broad duplicate registry.
preserved_controls: exact immutable source and candidate identities
fail-closed handling of unknown or ambiguous transitions
no domain-authority promotion by communication conformance
safe_automation_opportunities: aggregate pilot observation records into a non-authoritative measurement summary
validate shallow evidence-index pointers and immutable identities
extend existing document navigation orphan detection to the remaining required cross-surfaces
reuse unchanged formal attestations when material identity is unchanged
generate promotion-specific G8/G9 packet material only when a promotion transition is explicitly requested
interpretation_limits: The pilot does not establish that GCL-TCS is optimal.
The pilot does not establish a causal improvement in research quality, safety, correctness, throughput, or review latency.
Repository diff counts are not a complete burden metric.
No representative empirical false-positive or false-negative rate has been measured.
Candidate Stage-A protected merges are evidence-preservation transactions, not GCL-TCS promotions.
One successful Markdown orphan detection does not establish the full cross-surface orphan-detection criterion.
